Hope comes standard on every Hyundai.
Each time we sell a Hyundai, a portion goes to Hyundai Hope On Wheels®
to help find a cure for childhood cancer. Over the last 24 years, Hyundai
Hope On Wheels has donated more than $200 million. Hope is our greatest
feature. And it comes standard on every Hyundai. For more information,
please visit HyundaiHopeOnWheels.org.
